label: AI Beta Reader
description: Chapter-by-chapter reader reactions, engagement, and put-down risk.
usage: Prioritize chapters with high put-down risk; revise hooks and endings there first.
chapter_instruction: React as a beta reader to this chapter. Fill only the required markdown headings below (use exactly those heading texts). Use short quotes or location cues. Write "none" under a heading if empty. Do not write the full-book report yet—chapter notes only.
final_instruction: Produce an AI Beta Reader report. Merge the chapter notes below into one author-facing markdown report for this analysis. Group patterns across chapters, cite chapter names, rank severity where useful, and do not invent manuscript details not supported by the notes.
